verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser is an immigration law firm, so publishing its own preparation times and the government processing times it depends on is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack covers either: the material is about the Visalaw AI product, the startup practice, O-3 dependents and I-9 compliance. The RFE deadline-extraction prompt is an AI tool feature, not a published timeline, so it does not count.

support.subject: As a founder, expected timelines are published — the provider's own preparation time and the government processing times it depends on
